results.fact: Where the climb leaves the trail / base camp
results.evidence: The only external statement found (Peakware peak page, via search snippet; the page itself would not load) says the Chimney Peak approach leaves the Enchanted Valley trail at about 9 miles, with the chalet at 13 miles — which supports the bivy note, not the waypoint note. Wikipedia only says the easiest route is class 3 via the SW ridge and gives no departure point. The row itself is split: the chalet waypoint note says leave the trail at the chalet, while the approach and the same waypoint's directions say parties peel off short of the chalet. One source is not enough to rewrite the waypoint/itinerary, and bivy[] is out of scope for patches.

Wikipedia gives the easiest route as class 3 scrambling via the SW ridge, which matches rock_grade (Class 3) but not grade (Class 3-4) or the 'Class 4 Step' waypoint. No second independent source (SummitPost/Peakbagger/trip reports) could be found for this Olympic peak, and the row is itself split (beta, pitch_detail, approach and descent_text say class 3; grade, hazards, waypoint, partner requirements say 3-4/4). Left open.

No published route description for Chimney Peak's SW ridge could be found that locates an exposed class 4 step; the only external source (Wikipedia) says only class 3 via SW ridge. Whether the step is low or near the top of the ridge cannot be settled.

WTA gives 27.8 mi round trip, 3,700 ft gain, high point 2,035 ft; another hiking guide gives ~28 mi and 3,400 ft total climbing. Both are ROUND-TRIP figures and they disagree; neither states the inbound one-way gain, so neither the pitch_detail ~2,600 ft nor the itinerary Day 1 2,000 ft can be confirmed without arithmetic the rules forbid. The totalNote's '~4,000 ft round trip on trail' also differs from the itinerary's Day 1 + Day 3 gain (2,500 ft) and from both sources; left open.

results.fact: Direction of the peak from the chalet
results.correct_value: Chimney Peak stands to the north of the Enchanted Valley chalet camp
results.evidence: Wikipedia states Chimney Peak sits immediately north above Enchanted Valley, its southeast aspect rising 4,800 ft above the valley. The row's overview, beta ('north/northeast'), chalet waypoint note ('head north') and the pins (summit ~2 km NNW of the chalet) all agree; only the Day 1 itinerary note says west.

results.correct_value: 3,700 ft is the round-trip trail gain; 8,600 ft car-to-car = 3,700 ft round-trip trail gain + ~4,900 ft summit climb
results.evidence: WTA confirms 27.8 mi round trip with 3,700 ft of gain to Enchanted Valley, so the approach correctly labels 3,700 ft as round trip. gain_ft is a whole-outing (car-to-car) total, and adding the round-trip trail gain to the one-time ~4,900 ft valley-to-summit climb gives 8,600 ft — consistent, not a one-way figure counted twice.
